page.title: Role Management
page.description: Manage global roles, their members, and the modules each role can access.

listDescription: Administrators and Guest are built in; every other role is custom.

adminRole.name: Administrators
adminRole.note: Administrators bypass role permissions and can access every module. This list is managed here; permissions are fixed.

guestRoleNote: Guest is the fallback for users without an assigned role. It grants no module access and cannot be edited.

permissions.description: Choose the modules this role can access.

guestMembersNote: Users without an assigned role fall back to Guest. Assign them a role to move them out.
selectRolePrompt: Select a role to view its members.
addMemberDescription: Search a user to assign this role.
addAdminDescription: Search a user to promote to administrator.
searchUserPlaceholder: Search by name, email or username

delete.title: Delete role
delete.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? Users with this role fall back to Guest.
